PATHWAY MODULATION: No biomarker data provided to confirm pathway modulation, but the combination rationale of anti-angiogenesis plus immune checkpoint blockade is mechanistically sound. 3. CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Primary endpoint was met with 81.8% PFS at 3 months (95% CI: 63.9-91.4%), which appears clinically meaningful for advanced sarcoma. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: No subgroup analysis reported in this single-arm study of 33 patients with advanced alveolar soft part sarcoma and other soft tissue sarcomas. 5. CONFOUNDERS: Single-arm design limits interpretation, but the effect size appears robust. Safety profile shows manageable toxicities (7/33 DLTs, 9/33 SAEs) that didn't prevent treatment delivery.
